audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Independent Decimal Accounting Oracle Verification

accounting_equations_formulation.total_assets_definition: Total_Assets_t = Settled_Cash_t + Unsettled_Cash_Receivables_t + Dividend_Receivables_t + Sum(Shares_i,t * Price_i,t)
accounting_equations_formulation.economic_flow_identity: Equity_t = Initial_Equity + Net_External_Cash_Flows + Realized_PnL_cum + Sum(Unrealized_PnL_i,t) - Cumulative_Fees + Cumulative_Dividends
accounting_equations_formulation.verification_tolerance: 0.0001 USD (Zero tolerance under 4-decimal currency and 8-decimal share precision)

adversarial_scenarios_verified.description: Clean initial account opening with $100,000 cash.
50k buy reservation followed by 100 SPY purchase at $450 with 5 bps slippage and $1.00 fee.
Ex-date dividend of $1.50/share credited to Dividend Receivables ($150.00) pending payment.
Sale of 50 SPY at $460 with 5 bps slippage, proceeds moved to Unsettled Cash Receivables.
2:1 forward split doubles remaining SPY shares to 100, halves cost basis to $225.1125.
Clearing of unsettled trade receivables and dividend receivables into settled cash.
Injection of $25.00 exchange fee liability into Trade Payables.
Payment of $25.00 liability using settled cash.
Adversarial short sell attempts on unheld QQQ and excess SPY rejected cleanly; ledger invariant.
Adversarial 10k share buy exceeding spendable cash rejected; zero state corruption.

accounting_rules_confirmed.zero_liability_case: Under instantaneous clearing (standard backtest), Liabilities = 0 and Equity = Assets.
accounting_rules_confirmed.general_case: Under multi-day settlement or fee obligations, Equity = Assets - Liabilities holds universally.
accounting_rules_confirmed.cash_reservation_safety: Spendable cash strictly excludes reserved amounts, preventing intra-session cash deficit.
accounting_rules_confirmed.short_selling_ban: Strictly verified: orders on unheld assets reject immediately without share or cash mutation.
